detail.longDescription:
Easily find Bluetooth devices with Find Air! Never lose track of your valuable devices and gadgets again! Whether you need to find AirPods, earbuds, Bluetooth headphones, or Apple devices, this device finder helps you track them instantly, with an easy-to-use Bluetooth scanner to locate and find your lost Bluetooth device with precision.


Key Features of Find Air:

- Find my devices, including headphones, earbuds, earphones, smartwatches, fitness trackers, as well as phones, tablets, and speakers.
- Find Apple devices, like AirPods, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.
- Quickly find your device with our Bluetooth finder to locate nearby devices.
- Track all your Bluetooth devices from a single app.
- Simple and intuitive interface to find Bluetooth devices without complications.


If you're asking yourself, "How do I find my Bluetooth devices?", this app is the solution.
Download Find Air and always keep your devices within reach.

Choose from different subscription options. Our standard subscription options are:
1-week Subscription - USD4.99
1-month Subscription - USD9.99
1-year Subscription - USD69.99

--------

Subscription payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of your purchase and upon commencement of each renewal term. The free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription. You can cancel in the iTunes settings at least 24-hours before the end of each current subscription period. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free service. Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
